lead_independence.headline: Buc-ee's Clears Final County Hurdles, Spurring Growth Push on Indrio Road
lead_independence.lead: The proposed Buc-ee's travel center at Interstate 95 and Indrio Road in northern St. Lucie County has completed the county's planning process and now needs only final sign-off from the Florida Department of Transportation and the Florida Department of Environmental Protection before construction can begin. The 76,000-square-foot travel center would include approximately 120 fuel pumps and could become the largest Buc-ee's location in Florida. Buc-ee's has previously targeted a 2028 opening date.
